name: Anna Stürgkh - § 22 - Am 7
title: REPORT on electricity grids: the backbone of the EU energy system
part_text: 22. Underlines that improved cross-border interconnections offer substantial cost-saving potential at the system level, with annual reductions in generation costs estimated at EUR 9 billion up to 2040, while requiring annual investments of EUR 6 billion in cross-border infrastructure and storage capacity; notes, however, the increase in electricity prices in the two southern tariff zones of Sweden that are directly interconnected with Germany; stresses that any potential negative impact on households’ and businesses’ electricity bills should be minimised through careful and forward-looking system planning;
